column1: # *** RE-SOURCED FROM THE SOUTH AFRICAN GOVERNMENT GAZETTE, 15 September 2026. ***
# Free, official, and fuller than the commercial index it replaces. Method in the first row.
# *** Every line below was read out of the gazette PDF itself, not out of a search snippet. ***

column2: *** gendatabase.com's terms forbid republishing without written permission, and this archive published from it before reading the note that said so. *** Rather than strip the facts or argue about fair citation, *** they are being re-sourced from the South African Government Gazette ***, which is free, official, and carries the same information in more detail.
column4: *** THE GAZETTE BEATS THE INDEX ON EVERY FIELD. *** A Form J193 estate notice prints *** the estate number, the surname and forenames, the DATE of birth, the identity number, the address, the DATE of death, the surviving spouse and the executor. *** gendatabase gave years; *** the gazette gives days. *** Method, from the note both archives keep: the site itself is behind Cloudflare, but the PDFs are open at *** archive.gazettes.africa/archive/za/<year>/<slug>.pdf *** - fetch, pdftotext -layout, grep.

column2: *** '19962/95 - Lerena, Ricardo Juan Carlos, 6 January 1920, 2001065053080, 6 Barbeque Agricultural Holdings, Randburg, 21 December 1994; Doreen May Lerena. Standard Trust Limited, Second Floor, Standard Bank Centre, 304 Oak Avenue, Randburg, 2194.' ***
column3: Government Gazette, Legal Notices A, 15 March 1996, no. 17029, page 51 (repeated 22 March 1996, no. 17043, page 62). PRIMARY
column4: *** REPLACES gendatabase's 'born 1920, died 1994' ENTIRELY, and adds five fields it did not have: *** *** born 6 January 1920 ***; identity number 2001065053080; of *** 6 Barbeque Agricultural Holdings, Randburg ***; *** died 21 December 1994 ***; surviving spouse *** Doreen May Lerena ***; executor Standard Trust Limited. Estate *** 19962/95 ***. *** The identity number independently confirms the birth date - its first six digits ARE 200106. *** He is the 'RICHARDO JUAN CARLOS LERENA, major son' of the 1950 liquidation account of Robert Paul Lerena of Newlands, and he carries the name the 1908 enrolment card gives to Pablo Armando's father, *** Juan Carlos Lerena. ***

column2: *** '6746/71 - LERENA Nuno Fernando born on 6 October 1924, Identity No 331/406051W, of 24 Leiden Road, Gerdview, Germiston, who died on 1 July 1971, and surviving spouse Catherine Mary Sophia Lerena born on 25 March 1929.' ***
column3: Government Gazette, 6 August 1971, no. 3223, page 129 (second notice 1 September 1972, no. 3640, page 147). PRIMARY
column4: *** AND IT CONFIRMS ITSELF AGAINST A DOCUMENT WRITTEN TWENTY-ONE YEARS EARLIER. *** The 1950 liquidation account of Robert Paul Lerena made the capital payable *** 'only when Nuno Fernando Lerena attains the age of thirty years - i.e. 6 October 1954' ***, which implies a birth date of *** 6 October 1924 *** - and the gazette states it outright. *** Two unrelated documents, twenty-one years apart, agreeing to the day. *** New here: his address, his identity number, *** his death on 1 July 1971 ***, and a wife nobody in this archive knew of - *** Catherine Mary Sophia Lerena, born 25 March 1929. ***

column1: *** A TRAP IN THE METHOD, WORTH MORE THAN ANY ONE NAME ***
column2: *** The gazette prints in TWO COLUMNS and pdftotext -layout interleaves them line by line. *** A first pass on Nuno Fernando's page read *** 'who died on 26 June 1971' and 'Bedfordview' *** - both of which belong to the entry in the LEFT column, *** 6546/71 MARSHALL, Francis Cecil William. ***
column4: *** GREP THE PAGE AND YOU WILL COMBINE TWO STRANGERS INTO ONE PERSON. *** The only safe reading is to pull surrounding lines and follow a single column down. *** This archive caught it because two gazettes gave two different death dates for one estate number *** - the discrepancy was the warning. *** Anyone re-running this method should print context, not matches. ***

column1: *** DOREEN MAY LERENA - PARTIAL, AND SAID SO ***
column2: *** '16409/00 - Doreen May Lerena. Rapeport Incorporated, 107 Oxford Road, Rosebank, Johannesburg.' ***
column3: Government Gazette, Legal Notices A, 23 February 2001, no. 22069, page 47; repeated 29 November 2002, no. 24094, page 72. PRIMARY
column4: *** THIS IS A J187 AND NOT A J193 *** - an account lying for inspection, which prints only the estate number, the name and the executor. It gives her estate number and shows she was administered separately from her husband, *** but it carries no dates. *** *** The J193 for estate 16409/00 should be in a gazette of 2000 and has not been found. *** So gendatabase's 'born 1921, died 1999' *** stands unreplaced for her, and remains that source's fact rather than this archive's. ***

column1: *** ROGUE LUIS ARMANDO LERENA - the estate's 'LOUIS', and the spelling settled ***
column2: *** '1518/73 - LERENA, Rogue Luis Armando, 331/402089, [..] Lane, Florida (Roodepoort). Scott Brown & Tunnell, 500 Surrey House, 35 Rissik Street, Johannesburg.' ***
column3: Government Gazette, 3 August 1973, no. 3988, page 109. PRIMARY
column4: *** THE GAZETTE SPELLS HIM 'ROGUE', EXACTLY AS THE NATIONAL ARCHIVES INDEX DOES. *** Two independent sources agreeing on an odd spelling is worth more than either alone, and it means *** 'Rogue' is what the clerks wrote, not an index typo. *** New: his identity number *** 331/402089 *** and that he lived at *** Florida, Roodepoort ***, administered from the Roodepoort Master's office - a Johannesburg man, not a Cape one, like his brothers. *** STILL NOT ESTABLISHED: that he is the 'LOUIS LERENA, major son' of the 1950 estate. *** This notice is of the short form and carries *** no dates of birth or death *** to test it with. The identification remains an inference from the middle name.

column1: *** ROBERT PAUL LERENA - and an occupation stated in an official notice ***
column2: *** '1847/50/754 | Robert Paul Lerena, RACEHORSE TRAINER, of Newlands, Cape; First and Final Liquidation and Distribution | 20/4/51 | Cape Town | Wynberg | Dichmont & Dichmont, 6 Darling Street, Cape Town, Attorneys for Executrix Testamentary.' ***
column3: Government Gazette, 20 April 1951, no. 4584, page 103. PRIMARY
column4: *** THE MAN WHO DIED AT NEWLANDS ON 19 MARCH 1950 IS DESCRIBED BY THE STATE AS A RACEHORSE TRAINER. *** This archive had the occupation from *** his own 1940 passport, which says 'Trainer' *** - a document he supplied himself. *** The gazette is a second and independent statement, made after his death, by the administration of his estate ***, and it is more specific: *** racehorse. *** It also ties to a 1986 notice for *** 'Lerena Racing Stables' *** and to the NAAIRS file for stables on Koeberg Road, Rugby. The estate itself is already read - see data/estate-1950.tsv.

column1: *** WHAT IS NOW FREE-SOURCED, AND WHAT IS STILL NOT ***
column2: *** RE-SOURCED from the gazette: Ricardo Juan Carlos (full dates), Nuno Fernando (full dates and a wife), Rogue Luis Armando (identity and address), Robert Paul (occupation). STILL gendatabase's ONLY: Doreen May's 1921/1999; Roberto Juan Roque 1944/2022; Brigitte Zaage 1951/2023; Anton Armando 1952/2003; Patricia Carmen MacEwan; Jeanette Marie Riekstins; Belinda Maud Michael; Paul Raymond; Rhena May Barichievy; and the five deaths of 1999. ***
column4: *** THE THREE SONS OF THE 1950 ESTATE ARE THE PART THAT MATTERED, AND ALL THREE ARE NOW OFF THE COMMERCIAL INDEX. *** The rest are the later generations, and *** their gazette notices exist *** - 16409/00 for Doreen May should have a J193 in a gazette of 2000, and there are Lerena estate notices at *** 15127/2013, 017515/2022, 17814/2023 and 017114/2024 *** already located but not yet opened. *** Until those are read, this archive does not publish those people's dates as its own. ***

column1: *** ROGUE LUIS ARMANDO LERENA - the full notice, and he is the ELDEST ***
column2: *** '1518/73 - LERENA, Rogue Luis Armando, 6/12/05, 331/402089, 20 Park Lane, Florida, 29/1/73. Scott Brown & Tunnell, Fifth Floor, Surrey House, 35 Rissik Street, Johannesburg.' ***
column3: Government Gazette, 23 March 1973, no. 3814, page 99 (short form repeated 3 August 1973, no. 3988, page 109). PRIMARY
column4: *** BORN 6 DECEMBER 1905, DIED 29 JANUARY 1973. *** *** That makes him the eldest of the three sons by fifteen years *** - Ricardo Juan Carlos was born in 1920 and Nuno Fernando in 1924. He was *** forty-four when his father died in 1950 ***, comfortably the 'LOUIS LERENA, major son' of that liquidation account. *** AND IT OPENS A QUESTION THIS ARCHIVE HAS NOT ASKED: where was a son of Pablo Armando born in 1905? *** Pablo Armando was born at Rosario in 1882 and this archive still cannot close 'the eight years between Northam and the Cape'. *** A child born in 1905 may not have been born in South Africa at all. ***

column1: *** ANTON ARMANDO LERENA - and the contradiction dissolves ***
column2: *** '15127/2013 - Lerena, Anton Armando, 05-05-1952, 5206055175085, 158 London Lane, Knoppieslaagte, Centurion, 3 April 2003. Rapeport Inc, 107 Oxford Road, Rosebank.' ***
column3: Government Gazette, Legal Notices A, 16 August 2013, no. 36738 part 1, page 68. PRIMARY
column4: *** THERE WAS NEVER A CONTRADICTION AND THERE IS ONE MAN. *** gendatabase said born 1952, died 2003, and it was right. This archive's own row said '2013 ... 68' - *** 2013 was the GAZETTE year and 68 was the PAGE NUMBER ***, and this session read them as a death year and an age. *** ONE FIELD IS INTERNALLY INCONSISTENT AND IS NOT BEING SMOOTHED OVER: *** the typed birth date reads 05-05-1952 while the identity number 5206055175085 encodes *** 1952-06-05 ***. Every other entry on that page writes the date YYYY-MM-DD and agrees with its identity number. *** So the year 1952 is certain and the day is not: 5 June by the number, 5 May by the typing. ***

column2: *** '017515/2022 - LERENA, ROBERTO JUAN ROQUE, 1944-03-20, 4403205031083, c/o Rapeport and Associates, 107 Oxford Road, Rosebank; died 2022-02-20. Raymond Hack.' ***
column3: Government Gazette, Legal Notices A, 15 July 2022, no. 47011 part 1, page 115. PRIMARY
column4: *** Born 20 March 1944, died 20 February 2022. *** The identity number agrees with the birth date. He carries *** both his grandfather's and his uncle's names - Juan, Roque ***, which is the naming pattern this archive has been tracking across three generations and two continents.

column2: *** '17814/2023 - LERENA, BRIGITTE, 1951-10-16, 5110160070084, 12 George Fajans Road, Edenglen, Extension 1, Edenvale; died 2023-05-18, Johannesburg. Gavin Mostert Attorney, Edenvale.' ***
column3: Government Gazette, Legal Notices A, 11 August 2023, no. 49096 part 1, page 110. PRIMARY
column4: *** Born 16 October 1951, died 18 May 2023 at Johannesburg. *** Identity number agrees. She is the wife of Roberto Juan Roque, who predeceased her by fifteen months. *** Her maiden name ZAAGE is still gendatabase's alone *** - the gazette does not print it.

column1: *** BELINDA MAUD LERENA - with a date that cannot be right ***
column2: *** '017114/2024 - LERENA, BELINDA MAUD, 1957-01-16, 5701160094080, c/o 107 Oxford Road, Rosebank; (3) 2024-08-07; JOHANNESBURG. Raymond Hack.' ***
column3: Government Gazette, Legal Notices A, 2 August 2024, no. 51006 part 1, page 120. PRIMARY
column4: *** Born 16 January 1957, and the identity number agrees. *** *** BUT THE DEATH FIELD READS 7 AUGUST 2024 IN A GAZETTE PUBLISHED ON 2 AUGUST 2024 - five days before. *** That is impossible, so one of the two dates is wrong and this archive cannot tell which. *** Recorded as 'died 2024, day unreliable' rather than quietly corrected to something that looks sensible. ***

column1: *** DOREEN MAY LERENA - still not re-sourced, and the search that failed ***
column2: *** Searching the estate number '16409/00' returns exactly two documents, both J187 accounts-lying-for-inspection (2001 and 2002). Neither prints a date. *** The J193 that would carry her birth and death dates is not in the index under that number.
column3: Searched 15 September 2026. NULL - and a real one: the search ran and returned two results, not an error page.
column4: *** SO SHE IS THE ONE PERSON IN THIS EXERCISE WHO COULD NOT BE TAKEN OFF THE COMMERCIAL SOURCE. *** *** gendatabase's 'born 1921, died 1999' stands, and stands as THEIR fact, not this archive's. *** Her J193 may be in a gazette of 2000 that is unindexed or badly scanned; it was not found. *** Her executor, Rapeport Incorporated of 107 Oxford Road, Rosebank, is the same firm that acted for Anton Armando in 2013, Roberto Juan Roque in 2022 and Belinda Maud in 2024 *** - one family solicitor across a quarter-century, which is itself a thread worth pulling.
